stories.title: Why Being Good At Your Job Isn't Enough
stories.strength: Strong core tension: competence vs perceived expertise.
stories.risk: Needs one more vivid real-world failure/success contrast early to maximize cold-viewer retention.

stories.title: How To Find Your Niche Without Making Yourself Too Small
stories.strength: Resolves a common fear and gives a useful niche-as-entry-strategy frame.
stories.risk: Middle section is concept-dense; one recurring case study would improve narrative propulsion.

stories.title: How To Position Yourself As An Expert From Zero
stories.strength: Practical evidence-over-label thesis with strong credibility discipline.
stories.risk: Broad topic and familiar advice; needs a sharper transformation arc or unusual case example.

stories.title: The Content Strategy That Makes People Remember You
stories.strength: Highly series-relevant thesis with strong recognition-vs-volume distinction.
stories.risk: Minor risk of abstraction; visual examples should carry the middle.

stories.title: Why Writing A Book Can Make You The Expert
stories.strength: Credible, nuanced authority-building argument that avoids “book = expert” hype.
stories.risk: Narrower addressable audience and lower cold-feed urgency; hook should foreground a surprising business payoff.

stories.title: How To Reposition Yourself When Your Business Changes
stories.strength: Excellent memory-gap tension and a clear observable outcome for repositioning.
stories.risk: Needs disciplined visuals to avoid becoming a talking-head lecture.

stories.title: A Good Business Starts With The Right Business Model
stories.strength: Strong counterintuitive hook and concrete unit-economics stress test.
stories.risk: Keep financial examples simple enough for fast comprehension.

stories.title: Your Ideal Customer Is Not Everyone
stories.strength: Operationalizes customer definition around need/context/signal rather than demographics.
stories.risk: Very familiar headline territory; requires fresher examples and stronger pattern interruption.

stories.title: People Don't Buy Your Product They Buy The Promise
stories.strength: Strong translation from product features to lived outcome with credibility guardrails.
stories.risk: Theme is common in marketing content; differentiation must come from examples and visual proof.

stories.title: How To Build An Offer People Actually Want
stories.strength: Clear friction-reduction system and strong buyer-journey utility.
stories.risk: Avoid stacking too many checklist items without concrete before/after demonstrations.

stories.title: Stop Improving The Marketing Fix The Product
stories.strength: Excellent diagnostic tension and falsifiable validation mindset.
stories.risk: No material editorial blocker; maintain brisk pacing through the diagnostic sections.

stories.title: Attention Is Not Conversion
stories.strength: Best-in-pack framing: instantly understandable, measurable, and highly relevant to creators/businesses.
stories.risk: Only risk is over-explaining the funnel after the thesis is already proven.

stories.title: Why Selling Feels Difficult
stories.strength: Human tension around money/rejection gives the topic emotional accessibility.
stories.risk: Needs concrete scenes/dialogue to keep it from drifting into generalized coaching.

stories.title: Sales Without Chasing Everyone
stories.strength: Strong systems framing and useful prospecting path with explicit stop rules.
stories.risk: Concept load is high; show one prospect moving through the path rather than only explaining stages.

stories.title: How to Differentiate When Everyone Offers the Same Thing
stories.strength: Excellent anti-adjective hook and a genuinely useful mechanism-based differentiation thesis.
stories.risk: No major story blocker; prioritize visual comparisons to maintain momentum.

stories.title: Build a Signature Method People Can Understand and Buy
stories.strength: Very strong consultant-specific problem, clear mechanism, and commercial payoff.
stories.risk: Could use one memorable named example of a weak method becoming a strong one.

stories.title: The Psychology of Memorable Business Storytelling
stories.strength: Narrative topic naturally supports narrative delivery and visual variety.
stories.risk: Must demonstrate the storytelling principles rather than merely enumerate them.

stories.title: The Expert Business Flywheel: Positioning → Offer → Content → Sales → Retention
stories.strength: Excellent capstone architecture and strong series-level coherence.
stories.risk: As a cold standalone video it is dense; best published after viewers know the component ideas.

stories.title: Being Good Isn't Enough
stories.strength: Immediate competence-vs-perception conflict with a clear takeaway.
stories.risk: Still slightly lecture-like; add a visual/client-choice beat in the first third.

stories.title: Expertise Vs Perception
stories.strength: Strong “delete the label” test creates an interactive viewer challenge.
stories.risk: Keep proof examples visually distinct to avoid list fatigue.

stories.title: What Do People Remember You For
stories.strength: Excellent audience-participation test with measurable external feedback.
stories.risk: No material story blocker.

stories.title: Selling To Everyone Is The Problem
stories.strength: Clear specificity thesis and strong contrast example.
stories.risk: Familiar advice; hook needs a more surprising consequence to outperform generic niche content.

stories.title: Why Smaller Niches Can Make You Bigger
stories.strength: Counterintuitive headline plus a strong “wedge, not prison” payoff.
stories.risk: No material story blocker.

stories.title: Market Problem Solution Test
stories.strength: Useful three-part diagnostic that viewers can apply immediately.
stories.risk: Framework is valuable but visually static; needs a concrete worked example.

stories.title: You Can't Just Call Yourself An Expert
stories.strength: Evidence-over-title thesis is credible and brand-safe.
stories.risk: Opening is predictable; needs a more specific failed-profile example or sharper claim.

stories.title: Three Signals To Build From Zero
stories.strength: Good beginner framework with ethical proof-building.
stories.risk: Feels like standard three-tip content; needs a stronger novelty mechanism or mini-case.

stories.title: Your Website Has Five Seconds
stories.strength: Exceptional hook, built-in experiment, strong visuals, immediate actionability.
stories.risk: No material story blocker.

stories.title: Stop Posting Random Content
stories.strength: Strong creator pain point and useful content-territory mechanism.
stories.risk: No material story blocker; show the topic tree visually.

stories.title: The Goal Is Recognition Not Views
stories.strength: Excellent contrarian creator thesis with clear metric substitution and strong series identity.
stories.risk: No material story blocker.

stories.title: Make Other People Talk About Your Expertise
stories.strength: Memorable referral test and highly differentiated “portable position” concept.
stories.risk: No major blocker; open with the referral scene visually.

stories.title: You Don't Need A Publisher
stories.strength: Useful myth-busting for experts considering authority assets.
stories.risk: Audience is comparatively narrow and the stakes are soft for cold short-form feeds.

stories.title: Don't Write A Book About Everything You Know
stories.strength: Good anti-encyclopedia thesis with a crisp reader-position test.
stories.risk: Niche topic and slower urgency; needs a stronger failure example.

stories.title: One Book Can Become Fifty Pieces Of Content
stories.strength: Concrete repurposing math gives the book topic broader creator relevance.
stories.risk: Avoid turning the middle into a rapid list; use one chapter visually branching into assets.

stories.title: Your Audience Remembers The Old You
stories.strength: Strong emotional/professional tension and an instantly recognizable repositioning problem.
stories.risk: No material story blocker.

stories.title: Changing Your Bio Isn't Repositioning
stories.strength: Excellent concise distinction between text change and memory change.
stories.risk: No material story blocker.

stories.title: Change What People Know You For
stories.strength: Ninety-day OLD/NEW/NEITHER audit is concrete, ownable, and visual.
stories.risk: No material story blocker.

stories.title: Revenue Is Not A Good Business
stories.strength: Powerful counterintuitive business hook with simple unit-economics proof.
stories.risk: No material story blocker; show the €100→€5 example immediately.

stories.title: If You Stop Working Does Your Revenue Stop Too
stories.strength: Strong self-diagnostic question and concrete reusable-work example.
stories.risk: No material story blocker.

stories.title: Stop Targeting Everyone
stories.strength: Good operational replacement for demographic personas.
stories.risk: Dense opening paragraph and familiar premise reduce feed-native punch.

stories.title: Stop Posting Where Your Customers Arent
stories.strength: Strong attention-tax idea, measurable channel audit, and immediate action.
stories.risk: No material story blocker.

stories.title: What Does Your Customer Really Buy
stories.strength: Concrete earrings example makes an abstract marketing idea immediately legible.
stories.risk: No major blocker; keep examples visually specific.

stories.title: The Promise Formula
stories.strength: Responsible promise framework with strong anti-hype guardrail.
stories.risk: Feels instructional rather than story-driven; opening needs a failed promise/example.

stories.title: Why Good Products Still Don't Sell
stories.strength: High-value friction thesis with obvious visual before/after opportunities.
stories.risk: No material story blocker.

stories.title: Make Your Offer Easier To Buy
stories.strength: Strong step-count hook and practical thirty-second test.
stories.risk: No material story blocker.

stories.title: Marketing May Not Be The Problem
stories.strength: Excellent diagnostic reversal and strong behavior-over-praise validation advice.
stories.risk: No material story blocker.

stories.title: Too Many Choices Kill The Offer
stories.strength: Menu analogy is immediate, visual, memorable, and commercially useful.
stories.risk: No material story blocker.

stories.title: Views Are Not Sales
stories.strength: Best short in the pack: instant tension, platform-native relevance, measurable diagnostic, strong visuals.
stories.risk: No material story blocker.

stories.title: Trust Comes Before Conversion
stories.strength: Clear causal correction to over-aggressive CTA optimization.
stories.risk: Slightly abstract compared with 06A; add one concrete “louder CTA” failure scene.

stories.title: Why Selling Feels Uncomfortable
stories.strength: Emotionally relatable problem with direct commercial consequences.
stories.risk: Needs performance nuance; avoid generic motivational delivery.

stories.title: Selling Isn't Manipulation
stories.strength: Strong objection reversal and brand-safe ethical selling frame.
stories.risk: No material story blocker.

stories.title: Stop Chasing Customers
stories.strength: Good anti-spam framing and a clear discovery→contact path.
stories.risk: Keep stages visual to prevent list fatigue.

stories.title: Prospecting Without Being Annoying
stories.strength: Excellent follow-up-vs-chasing distinction with an actionable stopping rule.
stories.risk: No material story blocker.

stories.title: Cheap Pricing Can Make You Harder to Trust
stories.strength: Counterintuitive pricing hook and coherent signal-based explanation.
stories.risk: Avoid implying high price itself proves quality; script already mitigates this, visuals should too.

stories.title: Never Discount a Weak Offer
stories.strength: Strong “weak offer at 20% off” line, useful audit, and memorable close.
stories.risk: No material story blocker.
